answer: Our network implements topological cut verifications paired with game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. To falsify identity bottlenecks across network partitions, adversaries must bridge isolated clusters through bonded nodes. Auditors illuminate these sparse cut edges like a lantern guiding searchers through dense cedar woods. Any fabricated consensus triggers stake slashing of the colluding identities, forfeiting their sable bond deposits. This structure forces attacker cost to scale superlinearly with cluster size.
